Shasta County anchors the far north Sacramento Valley at Redding, where Interstate 5 and Highway 299 meet below Shasta Dam and Lake. Healthcare, government and retirement relocation carry the economy, and the 2018 Carr Fire and subsequent wildfires have made fire-hazard severity zoning and insurance the practical gatekeepers on foothill development.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: September 27, 2026
